name: Nehemiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return

points: Nehemiah, Ezra, and the Levites tell the people the day is holy and they should not mourn or weep, for the people wept when they heard the words of the law.

note.label: Nehemiah 8: Ezra Reads the Law at the Water Gate

points: Those that sealed the covenant are named, beginning with Nehemiah the Tirshatha, then the priests, the Levites, and the chief of the people.

note.label: Nehemiah 10: The Sure Covenant Is Sealed

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org

cases.name: Nehemiah
cases.charge: Fasting and praying before the God of heaven for the remnant; building the wall in fifty-two days with a sword in one hand; taking no governor’s bread; forbidding usury; shutting the gates on the Sabbath; remember me, O my God, for good
cases.preview: Nehemiah, cupbearer to Artaxerxes in Shushan, heard that the remnant in Judah was in affliction and the wall of Jerusalem broken down, and he wept, fasted, and prayed, pleading the promise to gather…
